scope: General finite electrical spectral code P with positive retained dyadic mass. Executed full four-ring all-matter Parent uses beta=1/1048576, C=2401/144 including all High on-site terms, E_star=9/50, d=14 or d=7 for fixed control, b=36. Six-pulse error is from the separately reviewed controlled-addition theorem; its large individually addressable bond amplification and actual physical source remain assumptions. Time is in Parent units. Measurement comparison is between actual-U on sigma_hat_P and ideal-G on conditional full Gibbs rho_beta,P, not empirical real-world accuracy.
